# enforcer-selfhost-plan

## Overview

This plan orchestrates the Rust rebuild of the Ocentra Enforcer.

## No-Read Routing

The following documents MUST NOT be read unless explicitly routed by hub or workpack assignment:

- PLAN_STATE.md (cross-plan state; only read from your hub mail)
- RUST_ARCHITECTURE.md (cross-track design; read only when explicitly routed to architecture review)
- Sibling workpack files (arc-NN, b0N, d25, x05) outside your assigned lane


## Workpack Index

See [WORKPACK_INDEX.md](./WORKPACK_INDEX.md) for the current lane assignment and status.
